source: resident.com and Time Out New York 2026 guides; organizers' sites (Nov 2026)

guides.title: Christmas lights
guides.intro: The best holiday light displays in and around New York this season, with 2026 dates checked against the organizers and local guides.

items.name: Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree
items.dates: Lit Dec 2; on view through the holidays
items.blurb: The city's most famous tree is lit on Dec 2 and stays up through the season. Go late at night or early morning to skip the crowds.
items.blurbEs: El árbol más famoso de la ciudad se enciende el 2 de diciembre y sigue toda la temporada. Ve tarde en la noche o temprano para evitar multitudes.

items.name: Lightscape at Brooklyn Botanic Garden
items.blurb: An after-dark trail of large light sculptures, projections across trees and water, and sound installations.
items.blurbEs: Un recorrido nocturno con grandes esculturas de luz, proyecciones sobre árboles y agua, e instalaciones de sonido.

items.name: Bronx Zoo Holiday Lights
items.dates: Nov 21 – Jan 3; lantern trails from 4:30 PM
items.blurb: Animal lanterns, glowing trails and musical light shows, with the Children's Zoo farmyard open at night. Regular zoo tickets don't include it.
items.blurbEs: Faroles de animales, senderos iluminados y espectáculos de luces con música. La entrada normal del zoológico no lo incluye.

items.name: Shine Bright at Hudson Yards
items.blurb: More than two million lights across the neighborhood and a new light show on the outside of the Vessel.
items.blurbEs: Más de dos millones de luces en el barrio y un nuevo espectáculo de luces en el exterior del Vessel.

items.name: Winter Lantern Festival: Illuminate the Farm
items.addr: 73-50 Little Neck Pkwy, Glen Oaks, NY 11004
items.blurb: Handcrafted Chinese lanterns, live performances and food vendors on a historic working farm. Free parking; under 3 free.
items.blurbEs: Faroles chinos artesanales, espectáculos en vivo y comida en una granja histórica. Estacionamiento gratis; menores de 3 gratis.

guides.title: Holiday markets
guides.intro: Where to shop local for the holidays in New York: Christmas markets, makers fairs and holiday villages running this season.

items.name: Bryant Park Winter Village
items.dates: Through Jan 3; Mon–Fri 11 AM–8 PM, Sat–Sun 10 AM–8 PM
items.addr: 6th Ave between 40th & 42nd St, New York, NY 10018
items.blurb: Over 180 holiday kiosks around a free-admission skating rink (bring your own skates).
items.blurbEs: Más de 180 casetas navideñas junto a una pista de patinaje gratis (trae tus patines).

items.name: Union Square Holiday Market
items.dates: Nov 12 – Dec 24; Sun–Wed 11 AM–8 PM, Thu–Fri to 9, Sat 10 AM–9 PM
items.addr: Union Square Park, New York, NY 10003
items.blurb: A European-style market with 185+ vendors, food, wine and beer.
items.blurbEs: Un mercado al estilo europeo con más de 185 vendedores, comida, vino y cerveza.

items.name: Grand Central Holiday Fair
items.dates: Nov 9 – Dec 24; Mon–Sat 10 AM–7 PM, Sun 11 AM–6 PM
items.blurb: An indoor fair with 35 local food and craft vendors, right inside the terminal.
items.blurbEs: Una feria bajo techo con 35 vendedores locales de comida y artesanías, dentro de la terminal.

items.name: Columbus Circle Holiday Market
items.dates: Dec 1–31; Mon–Thu 11 AM–7 PM, Fri–Sun 10 AM–8 PM
items.blurb: A parkside market of handmade goods from local artisans and food vendors.
items.blurbEs: Un mercado junto al parque con artesanías locales y puestos de comida.

items.name: Macy's Holiday Square
items.dates: Dec 3 – Jan 2; Mon–Sat 11 AM–8 PM, Sun 11 AM–7 PM
items.addr: Broadway from 32nd to 36th St, New York, NY 10001
items.blurb: Food, drinks and shopping steps from Macy's holiday windows.
items.blurbEs: Comida, bebidas y compras a pasos de las vitrinas navideñas de Macy's.

items.name: FAD Market Dumbo
items.blurb: A curated pop-up of fashion, art, design and food from local makers.
items.blurbEs: Un pop-up de moda, arte, diseño y comida de creadores locales.
